quest.context: The learner just watched the GenAI Overview live session and is doing hands-on work on their own machine for the first time. Likely gaps: Python 3.11 isn't installed yet, no familiarity with venv, no awareness of key-leak risk, first time calling the OpenAI API. Walk them through step by step: (1) check the Python version and install 3.11; (2) create and activate a venv in the project directory; (3) install the openai package; (4) create .env and add it to .gitignore; (5) write main.py and make the first chat.completions call; (6) if they hit RateLimitError / InvalidAPIKey, help them diagnose it. Key pitfalls: Mac uses `source venv/bin/activate`, Windows uses `venv\Scripts\activate`; .env must be added to .gitignore before the first `git add`; beginners often paste the API key directly into code instead of .env.
